name: Agent Transport
description: The carrier at one declared connection boundary. Protocols, framing, encryption, wake behavior and delivery evidence are separate. Classify each hop independently rather than treating a proxy chain as one transport.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: The carrier at this boundary has not been established or is outside the current vocabulary.

values.label: Standard streams
values.description: Communication through a process's standard input and output streams.

values.label: Unix domain socket
values.description: Communication through a Unix domain socket. The label makes no authentication or ownership claim.

values.label: Named pipe
values.description: Communication through an operating-system named pipe.

values.label: TCP
values.description: Communication over TCP, including loopback connections. Application framing and TLS are separately declared.

values.label: In process
values.description: Communication through a library call or event boundary within one process.

examples.dataset: HTTPS request over a TCP connection
